data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'hic' meaning 'this' and 'gignere' meaning 'to beget', Higinbotham is a name of noble origin. The name signifies being exalted or high born, suitable for a child born into a privileged family or destined for greatness. The name Higinbotham carries the meaning “Exalted, high born” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Higinbotham usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, high born and live with faith, good character and purpose.
